|descr= Sets radio trigger menu title text (0 -> 0 -> map radio). Use "NULL" to disable radio slot. Use "" to restore default title. 
{{Feature|informative| The same effect could be achieved by using [[setTriggerText]] (see Example 2)}}

|s1= index [[setRadioMsg]] text

|p1= index: [[Number]] - from 1 to 10

* 1 - Alpha (key 1)
* 2 - Bravo (key 2)
* 3 - Charlie (key 3)
* 4 - Delta (key 4)
* 5 - Echo (key 5)
* 6 - Foxtrot (key 6)
* 7 - Golf (key 7)
* 8 - Hotel (key 8)
* 9 - India (key 9)
* 10 - Juliet (key 0)

|p2= text: [[String]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>1 setRadioMsg "Click meeeeeeeeee"; //changes title of radio Alpha</sqf>
|x2= <sqf>_radioTrigger setTriggerText "Click meeeeeeeeee"; //changes title of whatever radio the trigger was set to</sqf>

|seealso= [[createTrigger]] [[setTriggerActivation]] [[setTriggerText]] [[showCommandingMenu]]
